body:
⚔️ CratePack – PvP Resource Pack ⚔️

🔥 CratePack is a clean and competitive PvP resource pack designed to make your fights smoother and your gameplay faster. Built for players who want better visibility, optimized textures, and a cleaner combat experience.

✨ Features:
⚔️ Clean PvP swords and weapons
💥 Clear hit particles for better combat feedback
🛡️ Optimized armor textures
🎯 Improved visibility in fights
🚀 Smooth performance for fast gameplay
🎨 Clean and simple GUI

Perfect for duels, Bedwars, SkyWars, and any competitive PvP server.

💎 Dominate fights. Win more battles. Play with CratePack.
